MolTalk 1.0.0, MIT (LICENSE in this folder). Upstream commit: 44da199621c8ef916ab615f8022ec141cf110262 (https://github.com/DomFico/moltalk), read on 2026-10-24.
Adapted in MolDesign, not vendored: the weighted proper-rotation fit of a 3D geometry onto a 2D drawing (`moltalk/conformer.py::_fit`: SVD without reflection, iterative robust reweighting, higher weight on stereocentres and their neighbours) is reimplemented in `backend/chem/elevacion.py::_ajuste` and `_pesos`; the per-atom interpolation between the flat drawing and the rotated projection (`moltalk/widget/molecule.html`, `Lift.project`) inspired `frontend/lib/elevacion.ts::proyectar`.
Not taken: MolTalk's conformer selection, its special-case geometry (VSEPR, metal complexes, porphyrins), its widget, its drawing code and its GIF generator. In MolDesign, Moldex rotates the run's own Vina top-1 pose; only the editor preview computes a conformer (ETKDGv3 + MMFF94, seed 42).
